name: TW Hide Price & Add to Cart for WooCommerce
author: Technology Wisdom

sections.description:
TW Hide Price & Add to Cart for WooCommerce allows store owners to control pricing visibility and purchasing actions for non logged in users.
Instead of completely hiding product prices, the plugin applies a visible blur effect so visitors clearly understand that pricing is restricted. The Add to Cart button remains visible but is disabled for guest users.
Admins can selectively apply these restrictions based on specific products or product categories, providing flexible control over store visibility.
Custom messages can be configured for both price and Add to Cart tooltips, allowing store owners to tailor the user experience.
Native browser tooltips appear when hovering over the price or Add to Cart button, guiding users to log in before continuing.

Key Features

  • Blur product prices for non logged in users
  • Disable Add to Cart button for guests while keeping it visible
  • Show tooltip messages on price and Add to Cart hover
  • Hide prices by specific categories
  • Hide prices by specific products
  • Supports combined category and product rules
  • Customizable messages for price and Add to Cart tooltips
  • Works on shop, category, related products, and product detail pages
  • Supports simple and variable products
  • Lightweight and theme compatible

How It Works

  • Logged in users see prices and can add products to cart normally
  • Guest users see blurred prices
  • Guest users cannot add products to the cart
  • Admin can control which products or categories are affected
  • Tooltips provide clear login guidance on hover

  • Show custom messages instead of prices or purchase buttons
  • Hide prices by product, category, tag, or brand

  • Automatically hide prices for out-of-stock products
  • Role-based visibility controls
  • Scheduled price visibility based on date and time
  • Category-based bulk pricing updates
  • Percentage and fixed amount pricing rules
  • Store-wide price management tools
  • Basic price change history tracking
  • Improved customer experience with custom messaging

Whether you’re running a wholesale store, private catalog, distributor portal, or B2B marketplace, TW WooCommerce B2B Toolkit provides the tools needed to control product visibility, pricing access, and purchasing behavior from a single plugin.

Privacy / External Service

This plugin can optionally connect to an external support service operated by Technology Wisdom.

Service: https://pluginsupport.technologywisdom.com

Terms of Use: https://pluginsupport.technologywisdom.com/terms-of-use/

Privacy Policy: https://pluginsupport.technologywisdom.com/privacy-policy/

The service is used to provide in-plugin support messaging, feedback forwarding, and announcements.

Opt-in consent (required before any connection):

When you activate the plugin, an admin notice asks whether you want to allow the support connection. You can choose Allow Support Connection or No Thanks.

  • If you allow the connection, the plugin may send: site URL, site name, admin email, plugin name/version, WordPress version, and PHP version. Support requests and review/feedback details are sent only when you submit those forms. The plugin may also check weekly for announcements from Technology Wisdom.
  • If you decline (or never accept), that data is not sent to the support portal. The plugin’s core feature continues to work normally without the connection.
  • You are never required to allow the connection to use the plugin.
  • You can disconnect the support connection at any time from the plugin’s Support page by choosing Disable priority support.

Support and rating forms also include their own consent checkboxes before site information is included with a submission.

Please review the service Terms of Use and Privacy Policy before enabling the connection.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress
  3. Make sure WooCommerce is installed and active
  4. Configure settings from “TW Hide Price” menu in the dashboard
sections.faq:
Does this plugin completely hide prices?

No. Prices remain visible but are blurred to indicate restricted access.

Can I hide prices only for specific products or categories?

Yes. You can enable category based or product based restrictions from the settings page.

Can I customize the tooltip messages?

Yes. You can set custom messages for both price and Add to Cart from the plugin settings.

Can guest users add products to cart?

No. Add to Cart actions are disabled for non logged in users.

Does this plugin work with variable products?

Yes. It supports simple, variable, grouped, and related products.

Is this plugin compatible with custom themes and page builders?

Yes. It works with most WooCommerce compatible themes and builders like Elementor.
